I am looking at GO enrichment analysis. I will take the enriched motifs found the MEME suite and do a few strategies of analysis.

Strat 1: taking list of enriched motifs names, breaking down pairs like FOS::JUNB into FOS and JUNB and doing GO analysis compared to all genes. -maybe filter for expression with RNA data?

Strat 2: Using GOMO analysis. this takes the enriched meme file of set 2 v set 1 and set 3 v set 1 and searches for the genes they regulate then does GO MF BP and CC for all the genes associated with being activated by that motif.

Strat 3: Overlapping Set 2 and Set 3, go analysis on unique TFs ### H3K27ac

GO_KEGG_analysis <- function(df,type, setp_value=1, top_n= NULL){
 a <- deparse(substitute(df)) %>% 
  gsub("_gost","",.)

# Prepare the table output
  filtered_df <-  df$result %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(source, term_id,
                  term_name,intersection_size, 
                   term_size, p_value)) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(source == type) %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_value < setp_value) %>%
    arrange(p_value)
  
  # Optional top_n slicing
  if(!is.null(top_n)){
    filtered_df <- filtered_df %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n)
  }

  table <- filtered_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_value = scales::scientific(p_value)) %>%
    DT::datatable(caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left;",
      paste0("Significant (p < ", setp_value, ") ",type, " terms found in ", a, " enriched TFs")),
      rownames = FALSE,
      filter = "top",
      options = list(pageLength = 10,
                     scrollX = TRUE,
                     scrollY = "400px",
                     autoWidth = TRUE))
  


# plot the table as ggplot object
plot <- filtered_df %>%
   # slice_head(n=10) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(p_value < setp_value) %>% 
  mutate(log10_p=(-log(p_value, base=10))) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x=log10_p, y=reorder(term_name, log10_p)))+
    geom_col()+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=-log(0.05,base = 10)), col="red",linetype = 2)+
  theme_bw()+
  ylab("")+
  xlab(paste0("-log10 p-value"))+
  guides(fill="none")+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color="black"))+
  ggtitle(paste0("(p < ",setp_value," ) ",type," terms found in\n ",a," enriched TFs"))

print(table)
print(plot)
}

test_df_k9 <- H3K9me3_Set2_gost$result %>% 
  dplyr::filter(p_value<0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(term_size<750)
go_terms_k9  <- test_df_k9 $term_id
scores_k9  <- -log10(test_df_k9 $p_value)
names(scores_k9)  <- go_terms_k9 

simMatrix_k9  <- readRDS("data/RDS_files/simMatrix_H3K9me3_set2.RDS")
  # saveRDS(simMatrix_k9,"data/RDS_files/simMatrix_H3K9me3_set2.RDS")
# simMatrix_k9  <- calculateSimMatrix(
#   go_terms_k9 ,
#   orgdb = org.Hs.eg.db,
#   ont = "BP")

reducedTerms_k9  <- reduceSimMatrix(
  simMatrix_k9 ,
  scores_k9 ,
  threshold = 0.7,
  orgdb = org.Hs.eg.db)

treemapPlot(reducedTerms_k9 )

Strat3 H3K9me3

Separating enriched TFs by sus only; acute only; and shared.

K9me3_sus <- setdiff(toupper(H3K9me3_Set3_data$motif_name),toupper(H3K9me3_Set2_data$motif_name))

K9me3_acute <- setdiff(toupper(H3K9me3_Set2_data$motif_name),toupper(H3K9me3_Set3_data$motif_name))
K9me3_shared <- intersect(toupper(H3K9me3_Set2_data$motif_name),toupper(H3K9me3_Set3_data$motif_name))

K9me3_acute_list <- RNA_lookup %>% 
  dplyr::filter(SYMBOL %in% (tibble(K9me3_acute) %>% separate_longer_delim(K9me3_acute, delim="::") %>% 
                               pull(K9me3_acute)))

K9me3_sus_list <- RNA_lookup %>% 
  dplyr::filter(SYMBOL %in% (tibble(K9me3_sus) %>% separate_longer_delim(K9me3_sus, delim="::") %>% 
                               pull(K9me3_sus)))

K9me3_shared_list <- RNA_lookup %>% 
  dplyr::filter(SYMBOL %in% (tibble(K9me3_shared) %>% separate_longer_delim(K9me3_shared, delim="::") %>% 
                               pull(K9me3_shared)))
H3K9me3_acute_gost <- gost(query = K9me3_acute_list$Entrez_ID,
                    organism = "hsapiens",
                    significant = FALSE,
                    ordered_query = FALSE,
                    domain_scope = "custom",
                    measure_underrepresentation = FALSE,
                    evcodes = FALSE,
                    user_threshold = 0.05,
                    correction_method = c("fdr"),
                    custom_bg = RNA_lookup$Entrez_ID,
                    sources=c("GO:BP","KEGG"))

H3K9me3_sus_gost <- gost(query = K9me3_sus_list$Entrez_ID,
                    organism = "hsapiens",
                    significant = FALSE,
                    ordered_query = FALSE,
                    domain_scope = "custom",
                    measure_underrepresentation = FALSE,
                    evcodes = FALSE,
                    user_threshold = 0.05,
                    correction_method = c("fdr"),
                    custom_bg = RNA_lookup$Entrez_ID,
                    sources=c("GO:BP","KEGG"))

H3K9me3_shared_gost <- gost(query = K9me3_shared_list$Entrez_ID,
                    organism = "hsapiens",
                    significant = FALSE,
                    ordered_query = FALSE,
                    domain_scope = "custom",
                    measure_underrepresentation = FALSE,
                    evcodes = FALSE,
                    user_threshold = 0.05,
                    correction_method = c("fdr"),
                    custom_bg = RNA_lookup$Entrez_ID,
                    sources=c("GO:BP","KEGG"))

saveRDS(H3K9me3_acute_gost,"data/RDS_files/H3K9me3_acute_gost.RDS")
saveRDS(H3K9me3_sus_gost,"data/RDS_files/H3K9me3_sus_gost.RDS")
saveRDS(H3K9me3_shared_gost,"data/RDS_files/H3K9me3_shared_gost.RDS")
H3K9me3_acute_gost <- readRDS("data/RDS_files/H3K9me3_acute_gost.RDS")
H3K9me3_sus_gost <- readRDS("data/RDS_files/H3K9me3_sus_gost.RDS")
H3K9me3_shared_gost <- readRDS("data/RDS_files/H3K9me3_shared_gost.RDS")


GO_KEGG_analysis(H3K9me3_acute_gost,"GO:BP", 0.05,20)

  dplyr::filter(cluster=="Set_3") %>% 
  pull(geneId) %>% 
  unique()
LTR10E_cs_all_gost <- gost(query = Ltr_all_3_cs,
                    organism = "hsapiens",
                    significant = FALSE,
                    ordered_query = FALSE,
                    domain_scope = "custom",
                    measure_underrepresentation = FALSE,
                    evcodes = FALSE,
                    user_threshold = 0.05,
                    correction_method = c("fdr"),
                    custom_bg = RNA_lookup$Entrez_ID,
                    sources=c("GO:BP","KEGG"))
